comments.author: @daviddaniels871
comments.text: The following started off as a good show in the first season. The actor who plays Joe Carol is excellent as a psychotic killer that orchestrates a cult of killers. But now that I’m in the 3rd season the show definitely jumped the shark. The first season had an excellent and unique screenplay. The second season was a little bit cliché but the third season the show just turned into Friday the 13th and another slasher TV show with a bunch of Jason’s. There should’ve never been a third season. Two seasons were sufficient enough to tell this story. Very disappointed with the way it’s ending and now that I’m in the third season since it’s now turning into a Friday the 13th movie I’m no longer interested in the outcome. It’s become a TV show of psychotic killer stabbing people to death and hero Ryan shooting people to death. Very disappointed with the third season and it should’ve ended in the second season with Joe Carroll  being put to death.
